properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] Package Manager / Dev-Tool Auto-Execution Triggers Non-Registry Egress or Credential-Store Access
properties.description:
Detects the supply-chain TTP that dominated this fortnight: a package manager or build tool (npm, node, cargo, pip, yarn, pnpm, ruby/gem) — or a freshly-dropped trojanized installer — spawns a child process or initiates outbound traffic to a non-registry public destination within a short window of install/test execution, often paired with reads of browser credential stores, SSH keys, AWS/npm/git config, or cloud token files. Driven by the node-ipc 9.1.6/9.2.3/12.0.1 compromise (StepSecurity + Snyk, 2026-05-15) exfiltrating to sh.azurestaticprovider.net/37.16.75.69, the pgserve 1.1.11–1.1.13 postinstall script harvesting creds to an ICP canister (StepSecurity 2026-05-04), DeepSeek-TUI CVE-2026-45311 auto-approved cargo test execution (GHSA 2026-05-14), and the JDownloader site compromise distributing trojanized installers signed as 'Zipline LLC'/'The Water Team' (CyberSecurityNews 2026-05-16). It spans Delivery (compromised package/installer pulled) → Execution (postinstall/require/cargo-test/installer run) → Credential Access (T1555.003/T1552.001) → C2/Exfil (T1041/T1071) and fires only when both the dev-tool process start and the off-registry public connection (or credential-store read) occur on the same host within ≤5 minutes. It will NOT fire for routine `npm install` traffic to npmjs.org/PyPI/crates.io/github.com (allowlisted) or for dev-tools talking only to internal mirrors.

Rationale: All four headline campaigns this fortnight (node-ipc 9.1.6/9.2.3/12.0.1 → 37.16.75.69; pgserve 1.1.11–1.1.13 → ICP canister; DeepSeek-TUI CVE-2026-45311 cargo-test auto-exec; JDownloader trojanized installer) share the same observable joint pattern: a trusted local dev-tool/package-manager process spawns a script interpreter or directly initiates an unexpected outbound connection that bypasses the known package-registry allowlist, within seconds of install/test execution. Correlating dev-tool process start with non-registry public egress (and optionally credential-store reads) inside a 5-minute window catches the technique without depending on any single rotating IOC, and the registry-domain allowlist suppresses the legitimate `npm install` baseline that would otherwise drown the signal.
properties.query:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let CorrelationWindow = 5m;
let DevTools = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","node.exe","node","cargo.exe","cargo","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","pip.exe","pip","pip3","python.exe","python","python3","ruby.exe","ruby","gem.exe","gem","go.exe","go"]);
let Interpreters = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","sh","bash","zsh","dash","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let RegistryHosts = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","crates.io","static.crates.io","rubygems.org","proxy.golang.org","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","nodejs.org"]);
let InstallSpawns = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | extend ParentBin = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | extend ChildBin = tolower(tostring(split(TargetProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ParentBin in (DevTools)
    | where ChildBin in (Interpreters) or TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("Login Data","cookies.sqlite","logins.json",".aws/credentials",".ssh/id_",".npmrc")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              InstallTime = TimeGenerated,
              ParentBin, ChildBin,
              TargetProcessCommandLine;
let NetEgress = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ipv4_is_private(DstIpAddr) == false
    | where isempty(Url) or not(Url has_any (RegistryHosts))
    | project DvcHostname, NetTime = TimeGenerated,
              EgressProcess = ActingProcessName,
              DstIpAddr, Url, DstPortNumber;
InstallSpawns
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DvcHostname
| where NetTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + CorrelationWindow)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, InstallTime)
| project InstallTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentBin, ChildBin, TargetProcessCommandLine,
          NetTime, DelaySec, DstIpAddr, Url, DstPortNumber, EgressProcess
| summarize arg_min(InstallTime, *) by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentBin, Url, DstIpAddr
| order by InstallTime desc
